notes.body:
Attached sample pcap files just in case:

[bgp-ls-flex-algo-isis.pcapng](/uploads/700790c859768a5c3f045561307161a0/bgp-ls-flex-algo-isis.pcapng)
[bgp-ls-flex-algo-ospf.pcapng](/uploads/347b3a1919cef9d4ecdf9ec022c2b397/bgp-ls-flex-algo-ospf.pcapng)

@alagoutte I tried to mean "Strict SPF" by the above abbreviation, as described in https://www.iana.org/assignments/igp-parameters/igp-parameters.xhtml.
If it's misleading, I can replace it by "(SSPF)" or simply removing the word "(SPF)" or just using the word like "Strict SPF".
Please let me know which you think better among the below suggestions? - 0: "Shortest Path First (SPF)", 1: "Strict Shortest Path First (SSPF)" - 0: "Shortest Path First", 1: "Strict Shortest Path First" - 0: "SPF", 1: "Strict SPF"
0: "Shortest Path First (SPF)", 1: "Strict Shortest Path First (Strict SPF)" ?
